title: Latest Leaked GTA 6 Video Shows Lucia Naked Amid Crypto Scam Fears
description: A new unauthorized GTA 6 leaked video featuring a naked Lucia has sparked community skepticism, with suspicions pointing towards a developer build, cheats, and a crypto scheme.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leak Controversy: New Video Surfaces Online

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster *GTA 6* remains at an all-time high, but so does the frequency of unauthorized leaks. According to recent reports from IGN Games, yet another gameplay video has surfaced online, this time allegedly featuring the game's female protagonist, Lucia, fully naked.

## The Motive: Pushing a Crypto Scheme

While the visual content of the video instantly grabbed attention across social media and gaming forums, reports indicate that the leak is part of a broader, questionable effort. The leaker has reportedly released the footage primarily to push a crypto scheme, utilizing the massive attention surrounding the *GTA* franchise to drive traffic toward their cryptocurrency project.

## Fan Skepticism and Technical Realities

Naturally, the community has approached this new footage with a heavy dose of skepticism. Many players and observers are questioning the legitimacy of the video, pointing out several technical possibilities:
* The footage may rely on an unauthorized developer build.
* Cheats or modded tools might have been used to strip Jason and Lucia of their clothes.

Analysts emphasize that this leaked gameplay does not accurately represent *GTA 6* as it will actually play at launch. Such distorted builds and hacked sequences are common targets for bad actors attempting to manipulate online narratives.

## Editor's Take

This latest leak is a clear reminder of how vulnerable high-profile games are to exploitation. Tying a controversial video to a crypto scheme speaks volumes about the leaker's true intentions. Players should dismiss these manipulated clips as unverified noise and wait for official updates directly from Rockstar Games.
